claims.statement: FALLBACKS unset selects same-provider chat models; empty or off selects retry-only; a comma list is an explicit allowlist.
Budget assert_allowed enforces optional input and daily caps; cache hits are not recorded; identity RPM uses Redis when available and otherwise an in-process window.
GET /ready is 200 only when providers are detected and Redis is healthy or unconfigured, otherwise HTTP 503; GET /metrics is 404 unless OBS_METRICS is on.
